turns.content: In equilateral triangle ABC with side length 12, D and E are the midpoints of AB and AC. Find DE.
Triangle DEF is equilateral. Use DE to find the altitude from F to DE.
The planes of DEF and ABC are perpendicular and meet along DE. Explain why that altitude is perpendicular to plane ABC, and hence determine the distance from F to plane ABC.
Treat ABCF as a regular tetrahedron of side 12 and use the regular-tetrahedron volume formula as the sole exact method.
Evaluate the volume exactly using the base area and perpendicular height.
Check the height and volume with a coordinate or right-triangle argument based on the perpendicular planes.
Report the exact volume of tetrahedron ABCF and identify the base and height used.
